title: The odd letters out
prompt:
Three of these words use exactly the same five letters, just in a different order. One word does not.

Which word is the odd one out?
hints: What do you get if you write each word's letters in alphabetical order?
Do all four words even contain the same vowels?
Which letters do all four words share, and which word swaps one of them for a different letter?
solution:
**Blown.**

Sort each word's letters alphabetically:

- elbow → B E L O W
- below → B E L O W
- bowel → B E L O W
- blown → B L N O W

Elbow, below and bowel are anagrams of each other. Blown shares four of the letters, but it has an N instead of an E, so it is the odd one out.
